newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to block Saint Gobain/Wacker Chemie deal.
newsitem.headline: EU to block Saint Gobain/Wacker Chemie deal.

text.p: The European Commission is expected to block on Wednesday a joint venture between French glass making giant Saint-Gobain, Germany's Wacker-Chemie and Dutch state-owned investment firm NOM in the silicon carbide sector, EU sources said on Tuesday.
The Commission's competition directorate-general has concluded that the deal should be blocked because it would give Saint-Gobain a dominant position in the 15-nation EU.

The sources said that European Competition Commissionner Karel Van Miert agreed with the assessment made by his services, better known as DGIV. He faced some opposition from his French and German counterparts, but that was not sufficient to gain the Commission approval of the deal, they said.
"I think it (negative decision) will go through," one source said on the condition of anonymity. Another source also pointed out that the French and German opposition was fading.
